title: Pocket Sub
tagline: NFT based subscriptions market with an app to allow and verify customers minted access
description:
Pocket sub is an NFT marketplace for subscription based businesses to list their services and customers to mint those offers as NFTs.
When a customer purchases a subscription from your store, it automatically becomes an NFT, offering you the advantage of organic marketing. Additionally, you can create limited edition offers that are available for a short time, allowing your customers to display their past participation even if the subscription has attained the end of its validity.
how_its_made:
This project uses nextJS, web3auth for web2 connection, hardhat, solidity with erc-4908. We have deployed the contract on base testnet.
The application acts mostly as a middleware between the user wallet and the chain as all the information fetched come from the contract state.
The image URL is part of the latest NFT metadata of a given shop and subscription id.
